title: Withdrawal at any time, in full or in part

source.title: Altshuler Shaham "חיסכון פלוס" gemel lehashkaa bylaws, March 2025, clauses 11–15

payout_business_days.notes: Paid within four business days of a complete, signed request; identical in the Infinity (1.7.2024) and Yachad Rofim (25.7.2024) bylaws. If that date falls in the first three business days of a month, payment may be deferred to the fourth business day. Meitav's product page also says "תוך 4 ימי עסקים".
